findings.current: Only one person remained in the place where countless people had come and gone just an hour earlier.
findings.defect: 한 시진 is one shichen, approximately two hours, not one hour.
findings.rationale: The draft halves the explicitly stated elapsed time and omits the established term “shichen.”
findings.replacement: Only one person remained in the hall where countless people had come and gone just one shichen—approximately two hours—earlier.
findings.source: 불과 한 시진 전만 해도 수많은 이들이 드나들던 맹주전(盟主殿)에는 오직 한 사람만이 남아 있었다.

findings.current: More than anyone else, he himself would have to lead all of them into battle once again.
findings.defect: “More than anyone else” suggests that others share the leadership burden to a lesser degree, while 다른 누구도 아닌 그 자신이 identifies Mae Jonghak alone as the person who must lead them.
findings.rationale: The source emphasizes Mae Jonghak’s sole responsibility, not merely his greater degree of responsibility.
findings.replacement: He—and no one else—would have to lead them all into battle once again.
findings.source: 다른 누구도 그 자신이, 이들 모두를 이끌고 다시 한번 맞서 싸워야 한다는 것을.

findings.current: The sturdy old man, Song Ho of the Thousand-Faced Fox, stepped forward as he answered.
findings.defect: “Song Ho of the Thousand-Faced Fox” incorrectly makes Thousand-Faced Fox sound like an organization or affiliation rather than Song Ho’s epithet.
findings.rationale: 천면호리 is Song Ho’s established sobriquet, “Thousand-Faced Fox.”
findings.replacement: The sturdy old man, Thousand-Faced Fox Song Ho, stepped forward as he answered.
findings.source: 건장한 체격의 노인, 천면호리(千面狐狸) 송호는 대답과 함께 걸음을 내디뎠다.

findings.current: After silently staring for some time at the old martial artist looking straight at him, he suddenly spoke.
findings.defect: 곧은 자세 describes the veteran’s upright posture, not the straightness of his gaze.
findings.rationale: The draft transfers a physical posture detail to the direction of Song Ho’s gaze.
findings.replacement: After silently regarding the old martial artist standing upright before him for some time, he suddenly spoke.
findings.source: 곧은 자세로 자신을 바라보는 노강호를 한동안 말없이 응시하던 그가 불쑥 입을 열었다.

findings.current: The energy rising like heat haze burned hotter—and at the same time more fiercely—than the sunlight pouring down from the sun.
findings.defect: The draft uses generic “energy” for Murim 기운 despite the binding distinction requiring “qi,” and “like heat haze” is missing an article.
findings.rationale: This is Murim energy emitted by martial artists, so the established term is “qi.”
findings.replacement: The qi rising like a heat haze burned hotter and fiercer than the sunlight pouring down from the sun.
findings.source: 아지랑이처럼 피어오르는 기운은 태양으로부터 쏟아지는 햇빛보다 뜨겁게, 동시에 거세게 타오르고 있었다.

findings.current: Tang Sadok, the Myriad-Poison Asura, had traveled a long way despite his crippled body, and his green eyes gleamed. The nuns of Emei Sect shed tears.
findings.defect: “Crippled body” makes Tang Sadok’s condition sound categorically and potentially permanently disabling; 불편한 몸 only indicates that he traveled despite his impaired or ailing physical condition.
findings.rationale: The source highlights the hardship caused by his current condition without labeling him permanently crippled.
findings.replacement: Tang Sadok, the Myriad-Poison Asura, had traveled a long way despite his ailing body, and his green eyes gleamed. The nuns of Emei Sect shed tears.
findings.source: 불편한 몸을 이끌고 먼 길을 떠나온 천독수라 당사독이 녹색 안광을 빛냈고, 아미파의 여승들이 눈물을 흘렸다.

findings.current:
Then a powerful cry, as forceful as any young man’s, followed.

“Your will be done!”
findings.defect: “Your will be done” carries archaic biblical associations absent from the formal martial acknowledgment 존명.
findings.rationale: 존명 is a forceful, deferential acknowledgment of an order; “As you command” preserves that hierarchy in natural contemporary English.
findings.replacement:
Then a powerful cry, as forceful as any young man’s, followed.

“As you command!”
findings.source:
이어 젊은이의 그것처럼 힘 있는 외침이 뒤를 이었다.

“존명(尊命)!”

summary: One altered time quantity, one weakened statement of sole responsibility, one misrendered epithet, and several localized fidelity, terminology, and register defects.
